thread:
sara_sales: Hey team — FinRegPros (EU-only POC) asking if we can guarantee that EU tenant traffic never egresses to APAC. They also want the current sub-processor list + a short note on pricing impact if we pin serving to eu-west-1. POC kickoff Wed, need answers before then :eyes:

alan_solutions: Short answer: yes, we can. We support tenant-region pinning (routingPolicy=regional_pin) for hosted; Dedicated/Private gives stronger isolation. Subproc list is linked below. Longer caveats in next messages.

mike_infra: Quick config sample for the routing policy:
```
routing_policy: regional_pin
fallback: nearest_compatible
allowed_regions:
  - eu-west-1
  - eu-central-1
```
Note: fallback avoids APAC if capacity exists. If capacity exhausted we might route to a compatible model variant in another EU region. If they need absolute no-egress, Dedicated or Private is the recommendation.

zoe_security: Security notes: our sub-processor inventory has EU-only subprocessors flagged. For Private we support customer-managed KMS/HSM and detailed audit logs. I can produce the security questionnaire answers and an attestation for EU-only processing.

danny_product: Pricing note: pinning to a region reduces our routing/multiplexing efficiency — ballpark +12–18% on hosted unit cost depending on traffic shape. Dedicated is separate (monthly commit + usage uplifts for reserved GPUs). I'll loop in pricing for a precise number.

pricing_bot: Rough estimate for their projection (10M tokens/month): hosted region-pin delta ~= +$1,200–$1,800/mo. (very approximate)

sara_sales: Helpful — can someone assemble a 1-pager + checklist I can send to the customer? Also legal wants a signed attestation whether any non-EU subprocessors will touch the data.

alan_solutions: I’ll draft the 1-pager + include the config snippet above and a runbook for the POC. Assigning capacity check to katie_eng. Subproc link: https://internal.redwood/subprocessors (internal)

katie_eng: I can validate capacity in eu-west-1 tomorrow morning and confirm scaling headroom. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for the POC to reduce token usage.

zoe_security: I’ll start the security Q responses and the attestation doc. ETA: EOD today. Will mark which subprocessors are EU-resident only.

sara_sales: Can we also get a short note from infra on fallback behavior if the region is saturated? Customer is worried about silent failover to APAC.

mike_infra: If routing_policy=regional_pin and fallback=nearest_compatible, we will only cross region if no compatible model variants available in allowed_regions. You can make fallback=reject to return a 503 instead — useful for compliance-sensitive POCs. Example: fallback: reject.

sara_sales: Perfect. Last: can we schedule a 30m sync with customer tomorrow 10:00 CET? Need Alan, Zoe, Katie on the call.

calendar-bot: Event created: "FinRegPros POC sync" — Tomorrow 10:00 CET — attendees: sara_sales, alan_solutions, katie_eng, zoe_security

sara_sales: Thanks all :raised_hands:
